C7c-04-acid-rain-formation-process

A flow diagram of acid rain formation. On the left, a factory chimney, a gas flare and a car release grey arrows of gases into the sky. The gases rise into a cloud where small droplets form. Rain falls from the cloud on the right onto a scene showing a lake with dead fish, trees with yellowed leaves and bare branches, a house with a rusted corrugated roof and an eroded stone statue.
C7c-07-biomagnification-trophic-pyramid

A biomagnification pyramid for DDT in an aquatic food chain. Four tiers from bottom to top, getting narrower: many tiny plankton at the bottom, several small fish, two larger fish, and one fish-eating bird (an osprey or eagle) at the top. Each tier contains red dots representing DDT, with the dots becoming much denser towards the top. A small inset at the top shows a cracked thin eggshell in a nest.
C7c-10-sewage-treatment-plant-process

A flow diagram of a sewage treatment plant from left to right. 1: incoming sewage pipe passing through vertical metal bar screens with rags and plastics caught on them. 2: a long grit channel with sand settling. 3: a rectangular primary sedimentation tank with sludge settling at the bottom. 4: an aeration tank with air bubbles rising through brown liquid (activated sludge), and beside it an alternative circular trickling filter with a rotating spray arm over a bed of stones. 5: a secondary settling tank. 6: a small chlorination unit, then clean water flowing out into a river. Below, a pipe carrying sludge from the tanks to a large closed, dome-topped sludge digester with a pipe releasing biogas to a gas holder, and dried sludge used as fertiliser on a field.
C7c-01-environmental-pollution-categories-landscape

A single landscape scene divided into three zones to show the categories of pollution. Top zone (sky): a factory chimney and a gas flare releasing dark smoke and a car and generator releasing exhaust fumes. Middle zone (river): a pipe discharging dirty effluent into a river, an oil slick on the water, dead fish floating, green algae near a farm. Bottom zone (land): a refuse dump with plastic bags and cans, an oil-soaked patch of ground near a broken pipeline, a farmer spraying pesticide. Small icons at the side for noise (a loudspeaker with sound waves) and heat (a thermometer by a power station outlet).
C7c-02-gas-flare-soot-pollution

A Niger Delta scene with a tall gas flare stack burning a large orange flame and releasing thick black smoke, a small illegal refinery with metal drums and a fire emitting black smoke in a mangrove creek, and in the foreground a house with black soot on its walls, a car with a soot-covered windscreen and a person coughing. A magnified circular inset shows tiny black soot particles entering a person's airways and alveoli.
C7c-05-oil-spill-creek-ecosystem

A Niger Delta creek scene affected by an oil spill. A broken, leaking pipeline in the foreground releases dark oil onto the water. A rainbow-sheened black oil slick spreads across the creek. Mangrove trees at the edge with blackened stilt roots and dying yellow leaves. A waterbird with oil-soaked, matted feathers on the bank. Dead fish floating, and a small canoe with an upset fisherman. A small inset shows a cross-section of the water surface with the oil layer blocking oxygen and light from entering the water.
C7c-06-eutrophication-process-stages

A five-step flow diagram of eutrophication shown as a series of small pond scenes from left to right connected by arrows. 1: a farm field next to a pond, with arrows of run-off carrying fertiliser into the pond. 2: the pond surface covered by a thick green algal bloom. 3: sunlight blocked from reaching rooted plants below, which turn brown and die. 4: dead algae and plants sinking to the bottom, with many bacteria decomposing them. 5: dead fish floating on the surface, with bubbles showing low oxygen.
C7c-08-sanitary-landfill-cross-section

A cross-section of a sanitary landfill. A large excavated pit lined with a thick clay layer and a plastic liner at the bottom. Refuse placed in compacted layers, each covered by a layer of soil. A bulldozer compacting the top layer. Pipes at the bottom collecting leachate into a tank, and vertical pipes venting methane gas to a small flare or collection unit. A fence and a growing grass cover on a finished section.
C7c-09-vip-latrine-septic-tank

Two side-by-side cross-section diagrams. Left: a ventilated improved pit (VIP) latrine: a small superstructure (hut) over a concrete slab with a squat hole, a deep pit below containing waste, and a tall black vent pipe rising from the pit above the roof, topped with a fly screen; arrows show air flowing in through the door, down the hole and up the pipe; a fly trapped at the screen. Right: a house with a flush toilet connected by a pipe to an underground septic tank with two chambers (sludge at the bottom, scum at the top, liquid in between), and an outlet pipe leading to a soakaway pit filled with stones. A well drawn at a safe distance with a distance arrow.
C7c-03-ozone-layer-depletion-schematic

A diagram of the Earth with the atmosphere shown as layers. A thin pale blue band labelled as the ozone layer in the stratosphere. On the left, sunlight arrows with ultraviolet rays are mostly absorbed by a thick part of the ozone layer. On the right, the ozone layer is thinner with a gap (ozone hole), and UV arrows pass through to reach a person, a plant and the sea. Small icons show an old refrigerator and an aerosol can releasing CFC molecules that drift upward, and a magnified inset showing a chlorine atom breaking an ozone molecule (O3) into oxygen (O2).
